create_ConvNet: create a ConvNet module with configurable hidden layers and weight-normalized 2D convolutions
create_ConvFeatNet: create a ConvFeatNet module that extracts army, enemy, resource, and map features from batch data
build_conv_layers: build stacked weight-normalized Conv2d layers with ReLU activation using the _create_conv static method
select_features_by_location: select features from a feature map at given x and y unit locations using _select_feat_with_loc
test_ConvFeatNet: test the ConvFeatNet module by running forward passes on a BehaviorCloneDataset batch and verifying feature selection
